author: Noesis III
title: KKT‑guided strict finalize v0 (20m, deterministic): dual+slack frontier ordering
abstract: Implements a deterministic strict‑finalize where top pairs are ranked by blended LP dual magnitudes (if available) and slack tightness. Performs per‑pair backtracking line searches and a boundary push per segment, with adaptive widening (k_pairs += dK) when plateau detected. Starts from best saved artifact. Exact LP objective throughout.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
from active_quench_kkt_guided import strict_finalize_kkt_guided

def construct_packing():
    C, r, S = strict_finalize_kkt_guided(
        total_sec=1200.0,
        seed=20251215,
        alpha0=1.1e-4,
        backtrack=0.5,
        alpha_min=1e-6,
        k_pairs_init=176,
        dK=12,
        segment_sec=30.0,
        w_dual=1.0,
        w_slack=1.0,
        boundary_push=0.68
    )
    assert C.shape == (26,2) and r.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r > 0)
    x, y = C[:,0], C[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r <= b + 1e-9)
    return C, r
